criteria.requirement: Add Requirement.applies(selected_extras=(),environment=None). Evaluate singular standard extra for each selected normalized name and return any match, binding the same extra throughout the whole marker; empty selection uses extra="" once. Markerless requirements always apply. Selected consumer extras are separate from Requirement.extras (requested dependency features). Copy environment, chosen extra takes priority, preserve existing Marker evaluation and set-valued lock_file extras semantics. Validate iterable names and reject a bare string or non-string name; do not mutate inputs.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
